newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPGs steady to higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPGs steady to higher in quiet trade.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices were steady to higher in quiet trade late on Tuesday as players focused on price setting and settling contracts, traders said.
In the Mont Belvieu, Texas, hub, spot propane traded at 49.25 cents and 49.50 cents a gallon, about a quarter cent higher than at midday.
Conway, Kansas, hub material traded at 49.50 cents and 50.00 cents, unchanged from midday prices, which had come down from a two-day rally on low inventory builds.
"It's been quiet today. It has been mostly a price day today," said one Houston trader.
The asking price for Belvieu normal butane rose about 0.25 cent to 51.00 cents, but buyers remained at 50.50 cents.
Conway normal was traded at 49.00 cents, unchanged from earlier today, traders said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
